scope: Technical recall at every character prefix
findings: Core recall offers a stored technical token but app routing removes the offer at terminal dot/colon prefixes.
192.168. and 127.0.0.1: lose offers; next digit can restore them.
fe80:: and https: also lose offers.
cause: TypingHistory.recall tokenizes raw prefix then requires raw.hasSuffix(trimmed); terminal punctuation trimming makes guard fail.
limits: Production core history plus copied app guard; no UIKit/simulator verification.
Same punctuation-normalization family, distinct suggestion-routing consequence.
